// diagnostic E1022

Jet.RuntimeOnlyAtBuildTime

{subject} while building, but `#Runtime(.Only)` keeps it to the running program

What

{subject} while building, but `#Runtime(.Only)` keeps it to the running program

Why

`#Runtime(.Only)` marks a function, method or block that runs only in the shipped program, so neither compile-time code inside it nor compile-time code calling it may run while building.

Fix

Move the compile-time code out of the `#Runtime(.Only)` code, or call it from run-time code. To stop only automatic compile-time evaluation and keep explicit `#run`, use `#Runtime(.NoEager)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.RuntimeOnlyAtBuildTime: Tests/UI/runtime_only_called_while_building.stderr.
